climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A Bulgarian PDO in the Lyaskovets commune. Its rules allow Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Gamza for red, and Aligoté, Chardonnay and Dimiat for white.
